name: Kiriya Kaori
source:
A housewife married for 5 years, but has no child.

She wishes for a child but has yet to be blessed with one, so she frequently have fights with her husband. Has a high libido, but she's frustrated with her night life because her husband mostly finishes by himself during sex.
